evidence.reason: At the current tip, `Hold.acquire` creates the marker with `O_EXCL` and fsyncs only the token file descriptor. It never fsyncs `self.path.parent` after the directory entry is created, so a power loss after creation can leave the marker absent on reboot and defeat the admission hold. This is a concrete durability bug in the existing admission mechanism, not merely a new hardening request. The release-side directory sync is not shown in the supplied region, but the acquisition defect alone supports the finding.
